title: sugerokia orientalis
intro: Sugerokia orientalis, commonly known as the Asian pennywort or centella, is a type of perennial plant native to the tropical regions of Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving cognitive function, and enhancing skin health. The therapeutic actions of Sugerokia orientalis include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and wound-healing properties, making it a popular ingredient in various herbal remedies. The bioactive constituents of this plant include asiaticoside, madecassoside, and centelloside, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
